name: mia-decider-2b
architecture: Qwen3_5ForCausalLM read as a System One decision model (decider): option-letter logits at the answer slot
questions: questions.json (one Choice with defined options; the same question was used for training)
default_scoring: questions-first layout with the question prefix cached (decider_config.json schema_first=true; Decider.schema(questions).batch(texts))
training_data: 76,112 Chinese short texts relabeled by an LLM, 褒贬混合 mapped to 中性, not distributed; plus 13,432 replay rows from decider teacher_data (15%)
trainer: python -m decider.train (github.com/Mapika/decider @ a5120cc), delta recipe with warmup 50 and none_prob 0
throughput: 375 rows/s on RTX 4090 (bf16, batch 64, question prefix cached); 129 rows/s with the question after the text
